title: oberna carpatica
intro: Oberna carpatica, commonly known as the Balkan rockrose, is a type of flowering plant in the family Plantaginaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in reducing stress and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Oberna carpatica include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and insomnia, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Oberna carpatica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
